content:
The **United States Secret Service** (or simply **Secret Service**) is a law enforcement agency operating under the Treasury Department of the United States government, encountered in Appalachia in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update. [2] 

If the player is a ghoul, then a disguise is needed in order to do their quests.

Founded in 1865, shortly after the American Civil War, as part of the federal Treasury Department to combat the widespread counterfeiting of the U.S. Dollar, the Secret Service later became the *de facto* federal police force alongside the United States Marshals Service until the creation of the Federal Bureau of Investigation. Other duties of the Secret Service include providing personal bodyguard protection to the standing president of the United States. [3] As part of this duty, the Secret Service maintained an office at Rapidan Camp, the presidential retreat in Shenandoah National Park in Virginia.

Shortly before the Great War, members of the United States government quietly removed the supply of gold bullion from Fort Knox and transported it to Vault 79 in Appalachia. By removing the gold from the well-known Fort Knox, the intent was to assist the re-establishment of government operation post-holocaust by ensuring that the federal reserve would be hidden from Chinese nuclear strikes and remain intact for use by surviving government officials. To ensure this, the Secret Service was placed in charge of protecting the vault and its gold reserves, alongside members of the United States Armed Forces, with Derek Garrison acting as the agent in charge.

Following the nuclear apocalypse, the Vault and the agents inhabiting it remained sealed, awaiting orders from the outside that the gold reserves were needed. At an unknown point, there was a mutiny led by an agent nicknamed "Shorty" [4] among the inhabitants, leading to many being killed and contributing to their numbers dwindling further over the years as at least three others took their own lives. [5] 

By 2103, rumors of the intact gold drew enterprising treasure-seekers to the region, and after attempts to fortify the Vault resulted in its reactor malfunctioning and some of their members turning into feral ghouls, the surviving agents were forced to enlist the help of a Vault Dweller from Vault 76 to rescue them. After the Dweller breached Vault 79 and resolved the problem, they were permitted by the Secret Service to leave with some of the gold they had been protecting as a reward for their assistance.

As a law enforcement agency of the former United States government, the Secret Service was outfitted with resources including weapons and armor to suit a heavily fortified bunker. Among the tech they had access to were specially designed suits of armor, underarmor, and power armor. By 2103, no produced units were left intact and only the blueprints remained, kept by Reginald "Regs" Stone.

The Secret Service appears only in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update. The faction is mentioned in and a member of it from *Fallout 76* (Regs) also appears in *Fallout Shelter*.
